messages:
Priya: Heads-up: VendorY just told us 5 racks are on hold at the EU port pending CE/EMC paperwork. ETA slipped from 2025-09-10 to "TBD" until paperwork clears. This impacts the EU marketplace pilot and a partner PR slot.
Gabe: Any idea which docs are missing? CE certificate or test report?
Luca-VendorY: (Vendor) Apologies  we discovered a paperwork gap on the EMC technical file. Our compliance lab is re-issuing the test report; estimated 7 business days. We can either: (A) expedite test report (paid), (B) Reroute 2 racks from our APAC pool for earlier delivery, (C) provide interim waiver for SI-only onboarding (no public sale).
Ivy: Reroute might be fastest if APAC stock is available and licenses match. What's the lead time from APAC?
Luca-VendorY: APAC to EU door takes ~10 days air + customs; sea is 28-35 days. APAC has 2 racks immediately available. Reroute would need updated manifest + MRA and incur cross-dock fees ~€4k.
Nate: For the pilot we need 2 racks in EU staging. Option B seems viable if costs ok. Option C also might work if Legal signs off on limited SI-only use without CE cert for internal testing.
Priya: Legal, can SI-only internal testing proceed without CE if access is restricted and we mark "not for sale"?
Ivy: Platform note: we can enable a partner-gated listing for SI-only but our compliance team requires a signed risk waiver. Also billing must be disabled until full certification.
Gabe: Finance impact: cross-dock + air fees vs expedited lab cost. Quick calc: expedite lab ~€3k, APAC reroute €4k + air ~€12k -> total ~€16k. Cheaper to expedite lab if timeline <7 days.
Luca-VendorY: Expedited lab slot available for €3,200, turnaround 4 business days. We can also ship 2 APAC racks overnight if you prefer immediate start.
Priya: Let's do this: 1) Approve expedited lab to clear all 5 racks asap (preferred). 2) As contingency, prepare APAC reroute quote in case lab slips. 3) Legal to draft temporary SI waiver if we need to demo pre-cert.
manifest-bot: PO 100221 status: PAPERWORK_HOLD by VendorY at 2025-07-02T09:12:03Z
Gabe: @Finance please flag if we can use partnership co-op for the €3.2k lab expedite. @Legal please start waiver template.
Ivy: Platform will prepare partner-gated listing and disable provisioning until we mark SKU certified. Need manifest + serials to pre-seed license tokens.
Luca-VendorY: Uploading expedited lab invoice and updated manifest with HS codes + serials in 2h. Will confirm ETA after lab result.
Priya: Great. If lab clears in 4 business days, can Marketing keep PR slot with "coming soon" language? We want to avoid full announcement.
Gabe: Marketing prefers holding public PR until cert. But they'll prep a partner-only briefing if Legal approves demo.
Nate: Action items: 1) Vendor to upload invoice + manifest (Luca). 2) Finance to approve co-op spend for expedite (Gabe -> Finance). 3) Legal to draft waiver template (Legal). 4) Platform to prepare partner-gated flag (Ivy). We'll track here.
Priya: Thanks everyone. Will reconvene when the manifest + lab invoice posted.
